To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the public respect for entrepreneurs, as a significant component of compensation for some employment, positively correlates with voting for pro market parties, and negatively with voting for left, in countries with different political regimes and different levels of economic freedom.

in the USA, during the classical period, the public respect for entrepreneurs was positively correlated with their election, while the opposite was true for public school teachers, lawyers and public servants.

in the US, the public respect for entrepreneurs, military officers and lawyers has been decreasing since the introduction of universal suffrage, while in Russia the public respect for military officers has been decreasing since 1993 and the public respect for businessmen has been increasing since 1993.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the relationship between the public respect for entrepreneurs, the public demand for "entrepreneurship as an occupation", the public demand for pro-market policy and the public demand for left-wing policy.
the relationship between the prestige of entrepreneurs in society, the economic freedom and the political behavior of voters in two countries with different political systems.
the role of the public respect in the formation of the political agenda.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the "expressive voting" is not a "trap" but a "lever" in the sense that the public demand for "successful" individuals in politics could be a source of positive externalities, and that the public demand could be shaped by the economic freedom of a society.

the positive association between economic freedom and voting for pro-market candidates is not only due to the fact that economic freedom is associated with greater prestige for entrepreneurs, but that it is also due to a positive association between economic and social freedom.
the public demand for self-made men is a positive factor in the process of market development, but it is not a necessary condition.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the USA, the "classical" model of public respect is still alive and well, and that the "classical model" of the USA is a good model for other countries to emulate.
the public respect for businessmen is an important component of economic freedom.
in Russia, as in the US, there is a positive correlation between public respect for entrepreneurs, economic freedom and voting for pro-market political parties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the public recognition and prestige of business is a significant determinant of the political behavior of entrepreneurs.

the public respect for entrepreneurs, which is an important part of the compensation for their work, is not only an important factor of the economic growth but also a factor of political support for pro-market parties.
the public recognition of the role and contribution of the entrepreneur to the society is an important component of a successful pro-market strategy.
